_divergence: Focus-ring RADIUS tokens RESOLVED 2026-07-05 (QA round #14/c) — item radius kept at 8; shipped as border/radius-default + focus-ring/radius-{primary,secondary,tertiary} (8/7/5), i.e. option (a) below. Coupling: the focus-ring token design is dependent on the TRATON item-radius decision (currently radius/radius-default=8; Helper/Focus Visible's built-in stepping 5/4/2 suggests TRATON items may have been intended at 4). Until the item-radius is locked, any focus-ring token risks visual mis-alignment. Path resolution options for the QA designer sync: (a) item-radius stays 8 → coin 3 side-menu local FLOAT tokens for per-layer 8/7/6 stepping per brand; (b) item-radius moves to 4 → coin 1 BOOLEAN token to toggle helper's Radius variant per brand (helper renders 5/4/2 naturally); (c) hybrid solution. Focus-ring FAMILY (offset, width, spacing) — the Helper/Focus Visible component exposes only Radius + Inset as variant axes. Offset / width / spacing are not tokenizable via this helper today. If brand-divergent ring anatomy needs to extend beyond Radius+Inset (e.g. TRATON wants a wider focus stroke than Scania), that requires either richer helper variants from the design-system team or per-Source canvas customization on each consumer. Not a Side Menu cluster concern.
